identity.description: An attacker uses TOR to establish network communication through an uncommon port, which triggers an ABIOC for abnormal network behavior. Cortex should detect the process initiating TOR traffic and the unusual port usage.

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: TOR Process Start with Uncommon Port
biocs.description: Detection of TOR process starting with communication on non-standard port
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = '/tmp/scratch/tor_binary'
| filter dst_port = 9050

abiocs.name: Abnormal TOR Network Communication
abiocs.description: Detection of TOR process communicating through an uncommon port
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.1'
| filter dst_port = 9050
| filter action_process_image_name = '/tmp/scratch/tor_binary'

xql_queries.name: TOR Communication Hunt
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.1'
| filter dst_port = 9050
| filter action_process_image_name = '/tmp/scratch/tor_binary'
